infoLinks.content:
Sunday 18 October
  • Buses replace trains between Parramatta and Lidcombe.
  • Trains run to a changed timetable between Penrith or Richmond and Parramatta only.
  • Change at Parramatta for buses towards Lidcombe, then take a train from Lidcombe to the City.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
 
Bus routes

Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses accept Opal. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruption and keep journeys safe.
